name: What bathtub materials are available and how do they compare?

mainEntity.name: What bathtub materials are available and how do they compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathtubs come in several materials, each with specific advantages. Acrylic and fiberglass are lightweight, budget-friendly, and retain heat well, making them ideal for standard second-story bathrooms. Cast iron and enameled steel are exceptionally rigid, durable, and scratch-resistant, though cast iron is very heavy and may require framing evaluation to ensure adequate subfloor support. Solid surface stone resin tubs offer a high-end, modern look and excellent heat retention for freestanding installations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic is lightweight and cost-effective, enameled steel offers scratch resistance, while cast iron and stone resin provide exceptional durability and heat retention at a heavier weight.
